headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.PartialRepairCorrection.finiteRow_variation
headlines.statement:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : Fintype A] (f : S → Option A) (count : A → ℕ),
  (∀ (a : A), count a = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.PartialRepairCorrection.fibreSize f a) →
    ∀ (k c0 : ℕ) (x : S),
      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
          (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.PartialRepairCorrection.finiteRow (f x) count k c0)
          (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.PartialRepairCorrection.row f c0 x) ≤
        1 / 2 ^ k

  (∀ (a : A), count a = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.PartialRepairCorrection.fibreSize f a) →
    ∀ (k c0 : ℕ) (p q : OAI.ContingencyTables.ResidualMixture.RationalLaw S),
      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.bindLaw p fun x =>
            Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.PartialRepairCorrection.finiteRow (f x) count k c0)
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.bindLaw q (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.PartialRepairCorrection.row f c0)) ≤
        OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation p q + 1 / 2 ^ k
